title: Bound deferred sum charts on staged helpers
body:
## Summary

- Construct a legal delayed sum of two staged helpers. Its complete local recursive profile and widths are unchanged; forward and cleanup add one scalar operation each.
- Prove why pair-only charts cannot omit the intermediate rank-four visit in the specified temporal model. A persistent mixed chart also fails the next fixed source frames. Include exact dirty-input replay and a separately implemented witness/check.

## Scope and limits

Both pinned PR4076 providers; rational/dyadic pair charts, fixed external source/frame boundaries and the after-B961 pair endpoint. The all-chart implications are written proofs from exact finite source data. Extra storage, changed source deliveries/frames and other consumers remain open. The positive construction target was not achieved. No full cost optimum, new supplier, physical/native-phase/owner/all-size/outer admission, formal-kernel proof, kappa improvement or selected-frontier change is established.

## Test plan

Tested commit: `2134efae620d8f841465ea6604120ba0006965a1`.

- [x] `python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/deferred-helper-sum` — both providers; all 723 input columns, including 91 dirty buffers; exact forward/dual/reverse and literal-cleanup checks; independent matrix/frame witnesses and 24 rejection controls.
- [x] `python3.12 -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/deferred-helper-sum --check-source-history` — all 36 committed files and source-only ancestor bindings.
- [x] Official export/integrity check and all four public normal/optimized commands in a read-only Git-free committed export, with empty PATH and unchanged sources. Local checkpoint receipts distinguish executed and digest-verified reused stages; the export wrapper is local orchestration only.
- [ ] Hosted CI — natural [run 39319220656](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/39319220656) is in progress on this exact head at the latest readback; no workflow rerun or dispatch requested.
- [ ] Independent human review — the separate mathematical review is AI-assisted.

[Proofs, exact original-source mapping, licensed source bytes and review](https://github.com/RossRichardson/integer-mult-bounds/tree/2134efae620d8f841465ea6604120ba0006965a1/research/deferred-helper-sum). [Canonical investigation](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/3606#discussioncomment-19049359). Canonical base `bb4bccbf`, priority 6; fresh overlap covers fully paginated PR bodies and discussions, not arbitrary diffs or novelty.

Ross Richardson with substantial OpenAI GPT-6.1 Sol assistance. Source licenses/notices are preserved.
